annotations.title: Quote forming a New York LLC

description: Prices forming a new New York LLC (or PLLC) together with its required publication, line by line: the $200 Articles of Organization state fee, publication in Albany County or the LLC's own county, and add-ons (an EIN, a DBA, PLLC licensing). Several LLCs in one order (up to 10, e.g. one per property) take $10 off each LLC after the first. Use when someone plans to form an LLC and asks what it costs.

count.description: How many LLCs in the order. Default 1.

dba.description: Add a DBA (Certificate of Assumed Name). One LLC only.

ein.description: Add an EIN obtained for the LLC.

member_count.description: For a PLLC: number of members. Default 1.

own_county.description: Publish in this county instead of Albany (usually costs more). Omit for Albany.

profession.description: For a PLLC: the licensed profession.
